findings.detail: Playwright ^1.62.0 is a dev dependency only, used exclusively by tools/
Three.js r170 loaded from jsDelivr via importmap at runtime
Only runtime network dependency is the Three.js CDN import; src/ has no fetch/XHR/Image loaders
No external art assets observed at the pin; all textures, meshes, and audio are procedural
Builder-to-blind-critic pattern documented in PROMPT.md with honest scores
Deterministic capture documented: single evaluate pause/renderOnce/read/resume; 1-px readPixels sync
npm run serve, npm run shoot, npm install not authorized; enforced by manifest execution_policy
